transformations.note: Each generic contact file splits by label into exact ordinary, offer and follow-up entries plus the group invitation parts. label_mappings carries one row per (source_path, label) occurrence with the exact target entry ids transcribed from specification sections 13.1 through 13.7; every id appears verbatim in that specification. The relation is neither one-to-one nor total, and the rows record that directly: sixteen group-open labels converge onto eight group entries; fifteen daily_message labels reach no entry because specification 7.1 fixes exactly six ordinary replyable messages and Day 7 has none; three history labels reach no entry at all; and a nevermind or missed_question label sits in the file for the day AFTER the invitation window it closes, so its locator shifts one day back. target_entry_ids lists exactly the entries these legacy labels reach. Specification sections 13.1 through 13.7 additionally enumerate contact entries that no legacy label produces, among them contact.invitation.ending.sylvia.day7.offer, contact.invitation.group.priscilla_lavinia.day2.offer, contact.invitation.group.priscilla_lavinia.day6.offer, the group busy, judge, nevermind and missed_question follow-ups and the contact.hospital_care entries; those have no legacy source here and Task 2 owns them.
The single undiscriminated hospital.faint source becomes one day-scoped entry per day, hospital.faint.day1 through hospital.faint.day7, one per day master.

label_mappings.label: ending.priscilla_lavinia
label_mappings.reason: spec 13.8 enumerates no callable entry for this legacy label; its nearest stable ending ids are ending.alone, ending.priscilla_lavinia.dark, ending.priscilla_lavinia.observer, ending.priscilla_lavinia.sweet and choosing one would alias a neighbour

transformations.note: The five old ending files split into the eighteen approved presentation entries of specification 13.8, which expand thirteen stable ending identities. Observer and Special identities each expand to a full and a residue entry; alone expands to normal and dark_mode. label_mappings carries one row per (source_path, label) occurrence, resolved by looking up the 13.8 row for that label. Commit 9114351031ffd874b7079e6df12da915c4d27808 renamed the three retired ending.*.true labels in one pass but not consistently: sylvia took the specification word special, while lavinia and priscilla took observation, a word 13.8 never uses as an ending identity. Those two occupy the same structural slot as ending.sylvia.special and resolve to the observer rows of 13.8; each carries legacy_name_is_non_canonical so a consumer detects the divergence without parsing prose, and bead dwm-ihm tracks correcting the spelling in the timeline at physical cutover. The single undifferentiated ending.priscilla_lavinia label names none of its three ending ids and is recorded unmapped rather than aliased. target_entry_ids stays the full eighteen because these five files are the source of every presentation entry; the four entries no row reaches are the sweet, dark and observer entries of the Priscilla-Lavinia pairing that label never differentiated.

A saved checkpoint that names one is rejected on restore and is never aliased to an Observer entry.
